title: MinimalCraft
description: A minimalist resource pack for Minecraft that replaces detailed textures with clean, flat visuals and soft colors, perfect for those seeking clarity and a clean style in the game.
body:
MinimalCraft is a resource pack that reimagines Minecraft textures with a **flat and minimalist** look. Each texture was carefully designed with soft color palettes, simplified shapes, and minimal visual noise, delivering a clean experience without losing the identity of the original blocks and items.

If you enjoy modern aesthetics, flat designs, or simply want a more visually pleasing Minecraft, MinimalCraft is for you.

### ✨ Features

- 🧱 **174+ block textures**: Stone, dirt, woods, ores, concrete, wool, terracotta, bricks, and much more
- ⚔️ **100+ item textures**: Tools, armor, food, materials, and everyday items
- 🎯 **16x16 resolution**: Same vanilla resolution, no performance impact
- 🎨 **Consistent color palette**: Flat and harmonious colors throughout the pack
- 🔲 **Flat/minimalist design**: No excessive noise, clean and readable textures
- 🧩 **274 textures in total**: Broad coverage of the most used blocks and items
- ⚡ **Zero FPS impact**: Lightweight and optimized files

### 📦 What's Included?

**Blocks:**
- Natural blocks (stone, dirt, sand, gravel, snow, clay)
- Woods (oak, birch, spruce, jungle, acacia, dark oak: planks, logs, and leaves)
- Ores (coal, iron, gold, diamond, emerald, lapis, redstone, copper, nether quartz)
- Deepslate ores
- Ore blocks (iron, gold, diamond, emerald, netherite, lapis, redstone, copper, coal)
- All 16 concrete colors
- All 16 wool colors
- All 16 terracotta colors
- Nether blocks (netherrack, blackstone, basalt, nether bricks, soul sand/soil, glowstone, shroomlight)
- End blocks (end stone, end stone bricks, purpur)
- Functional blocks (crafting table, furnace, enchanting table, jukebox, note block, bookshelf, chest, TNT)
- Decorative blocks (prismarine, bricks, smooth stone, glass, ice, obsidian)

**Items:**
- Full tool sets (wood, stone, iron, gold, diamond, netherite: pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe, sword)
- Armor (iron, diamond, netherite: helmet, chestplate, leggings, boots)
- Food (bread, steak, chicken, fish, potato, carrot, apple, melon, cookie, pie, and more)
- Materials (ingots, gems, redstone, gunpowder, leather, feather, bone, ender pearl, etc.)
- Utilities (bucket, map, compass, clock, torch, bow, arrow, fishing rod, shield)
